identity_evidence.quote: Toward Inference Latency Optimization for Scalable Collaborative Multi-UAV Analytics

primary_full_report.rationale: Published 14-page peer-reviewed journal article in IEEE Transactions on Green Communications and Networking (vol. 10, pp. 1364-1377, 2026) with complete models, algorithms, complexity analysis, simulations, and references.
primary_full_report.quote: Received 22 February 2025; revised 28 August 2025; accepted 20 October 2025. Date of publication 27 October 2025; date of current version 23 December 2025.

multi_uav_evaluated.rationale: Evaluates collaborative multi-UAV video analytics across UAV swarm scales of V = 5, 10, 20, 40, 60, 100, and 200 UAVs under both centralized (JDTSO) and distributed (MAPDP) modes.
multi_uav_evaluated.quote: Fig. 3 compares the average inference latency of different algorithms across UAV counts ranging from 5 to 200.

collaborative_inference.rationale: Models each video analytics task as a DAG of cascading YOLOv3-tiny DNN classifiers, selects classifier-level DAG partition points, and offloads remaining DAG stages to adjacent UAVs jointly with deployment and bandwidth allocation via JDTSO and MAPDP.
collaborative_inference.quote: Object classification continues until the DAG partition points are reached on the UAVs. At the same time, tasks are offloaded to adjacent UAVs for further classification beyond the DAG partition points.

evaluative_evidence.rationale: Conducts PyTorch/CVXPY simulation experiments parameterized by pre-measured YOLOv3-tiny Raspberry Pi 3B+ plus NCS1/NCS2 latency and power profiles, comparing JDTSO and MAPDP against five baselines on latency, energy, and throughput.
evaluative_evidence.quote: We perform extensive simulations to evaluate our algorithm's performance under various conditions, and compare it with other benchmark solutions.
